title: Predicting Process-Level Behavior: A Benchmarking Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.24425v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive process monitoring (PPM) typically forecasts the future of individual process instances, hence operating on trace level. Process managers, however, typically operate on process level, e.g., when assigning staff or calculating KPIs. The question is how well such process-level managerial decisions are supported by existing approaches, given that PPM research has so far not focused on process-level predictions. We answer this question through a comprehensive benchmarking study of two process-level prediction tasks: concurrent trace prediction and average throughput time prediction. Across synthetic and real-life event logs, we compare statistical and machine-learning-based methods, foundation models, business process simulation, and, importantly, established trace-level PPM approaches, aggregating their predictions to the process-level. translated_title: 预测流程级行为：一项基准测试研究
translated_abstract: 预测性流程监控（PPM）通常预测单个流程实例的未来情况，即在轨迹（trace）级别上进行运作。然而，流程管理者通常是在流程级别上进行决策的，例如在分配员工或计算关键绩效指标（KPI）时。鉴于PPM研究至今尚未专注于流程级预测，一个问题是：现有方法对这类流程级管理决策的支持程度究竟如何。我们通过对两项流程级预测任务——并发轨迹预测和平均吞吐时间预测——的全面基准测试研究来回答这一问题。在合成事件日志和真实事件日志上，我们比较了统计方法和基于机器学习的方法、基础模型、业务流程仿真，以及（这一点尤为重要）已被广泛采用的轨迹级PPM方法——我们将其预测结果聚合到流程级别。我们评估了哪些建模范式最适合用于预测流程级行为。
tldr: 该论文通过对并发轨迹预测和平均吞吐时间预测两项流程级任务的全面基准测试，比较了统计方法、机器学习方法、基础模型、业务流程仿真以及聚合到流程级的轨迹级PPM方法，揭示了最适合预测流程级行为的建模范式。
en_tdlr: This comprehensive benchmarking study compares statistical and machine-learning methods, foundation models, business process simulation, and aggregated trace-level PPM approaches on two process-level prediction tasks—concurrent trace prediction and average throughput time prediction—to identify which modeling paradigms best support process-level managerial decisions.
